description: Fault, anomaly and status categories used by the ORBITALIS diagnostic rules.

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: No documented condition matched and no ML anomaly was found.

anomalous_behaviour.label: Anomalous behaviour
anomalous_behaviour.description: The ML model flagged unusual behaviour that no documented fault condition explains. This is not a physical fault diagnosis.

possible_documented_fault.label: Possible documented fault
possible_documented_fault.description: A published failure condition from the research was satisfied. It is a possible fault, not a confirmed one.

insufficient_evidence.label: Insufficient evidence
insufficient_evidence.description: Required evidence is missing or cannot be verified, so no fault is claimed.

conflicting_evidence.label: Conflicting diagnostic evidence
conflicting_evidence.description: More than one different documented fault condition matched; all are retained and the highest-ranked is shown first.

type1_solar_panel_failure.definition: V_i(t) < 1200 mV on one or more panels at any observation time

faults.name: Solar panel failure (Type 1)
faults.description: Voltage reads below the expected threshold of 1200 mV. A panel of two series cells that is merely not illuminated still reads 1200-1500 mV, so lower values indicate a bad voltage condition (more than one cell).
characteristics: may persist for the whole orbit (panel produces no usable voltage)
faults.dataset_compatibility: Applicable to every session: needs only the voltage column.
faults.severity_basis: ORBITALIS classification: affects a whole panel (more than one cell, SRC-1 Section 3.1). Severity is not a value defined by the paper.

faults.name: Solar cell failure (Type 2)
faults.description: One compromised cell of a panel: voltage stays in 2000-3000 mV for consecutive samples while the current is below 50 mA. Only noticeable while the panel is illuminated; the same pattern can occur briefly at eclipse transitions, which is why neighbouring samples are required.
characteristics: 2000-3000 mV on samples t-1, t, t+1
faults.dataset_compatibility: Needs voltage and current columns plus a contiguous time series (5 s). Without verifiable neighbours the system reports insufficient evidence.
faults.severity_basis: ORBITALIS classification: one cell of a panel is affected (SRC-1 Section 3.1.2). Severity is not a value defined by the paper.

faults.name: Unexplained anomalous behaviour
faults.description: Isolation Forest flagged unusual telemetry but no documented fault condition matched. Possible causes include unmodelled operating conditions; no fault is claimed.
characteristics: ML anomaly without a matching documented condition
faults.dataset_compatibility: Applicable wherever the ML detector can score samples.
faults.severity_basis: ORBITALIS design: needs review, evidence is statistical only.

faults.name: Insufficient evidence
faults.description: A documented condition may be present but the evidence needed to verify it (for example contiguous neighbouring samples) is missing, or the ML result is unavailable.

faults.name: Normal operation
faults.description: No documented condition matched and the ML detector found no anomaly.
